# Bond (security master) (`bond` v1)

A listed bond: terms, price, yield, spreads and analytics.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `BND` · **Identifiers:** `BND-…` in `isin`

Open one with `BND <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: bond
version: 1
description: "A listed bond: terms, price, yield, spreads and analytics."
match: { kind: bond, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Bond (security master), id: $.isin }
strip:
  - { label: Issuer, bind: $.issuerName }
  - { label: Coupon, bind: $.coupon, fmt: pct4 }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturity, fmt: date }
  - { label: Price, bind: $.price, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Yield, bind: $.yield, fmt: pct4 }
  - { label: Z-spread, bind: $.zSpread, fmt: bp1 }
  - { label: Duration, bind: $.modDuration, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Rating, bind: $.rating }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    key: F2
    rows: $.terms
  - id: coupons
    kind: table
    title: Coupons
    key: F3
    rows: $.coupons
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Coupon, bind: "@.amount", fmt: amount2 }
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: "Price, last 30 days"
    area: right
    rows: $.history
    x: date
    y: price
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.issuer, 'issuer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
